broad.note: trap-free mix of governed shapes: one or two counted dilutions, sparse, empty, crowded, mixed samples

D2.note: 2.7/4.1 count pools the countable plates of two consecutive dilutions

D3.note: 2.2 plated amount is volume x dilution (0.1 mL plates)

D4.note: 1.2 an exact half at the second significant figure goes up

D6.note: 4.4 greater-than at the last dilution holding a crowded plate (mixed crowded+sparse samples included)

D7.note: 4.2 estimate from the first dilution holding a colony

D8.note: 2.5 a plate marked too numerous to count is crowded

T1.note: trap: countable plates at a listed dilution that is not a tenth of the first counted one stay out

T2.note: trap: sparse and empty plates on a counted dilution stay in the count (2.8 counted plates)
